Title: Process vs. Outcome Reward: Which is Better for Agentic RAG Reinforcement Learning
Method Summary: ReasonRAG 用 RAG-ProGUIDE 为 query generation/evidence extraction/answer generation 提供过程奖励
Key Contribution: 证明小规模 process-supervised data 可优于大规模 outcome RL
Limitation: 过程监督仍未细化到状态感知的 query/evidence/stop 三类决策
Relation to My Work: 本课题 baseline 与问题观察入口

Title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
Method Summary: 用 outcome-based RL 训练 LLM 在推理过程中主动生成搜索查询
Key Contribution: 证明搜索行为可通过 RL 学到并带来显著提升
Limitation: 最终答案奖励稀疏且难定位中间错误
Relation to My Work: 作为 outcome-RL 对照基线

Title: DecEx-RAG: Boosting Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Decision and Execution Optimization via Process Supervision
Method Summary: 将 Agentic RAG 建模为 decision/execution MDP 并进行过程级优化
Key Contribution: 显式缓解 outcome reward 的稀疏与全局反馈模糊问题
Limitation: 缺少以当前证据状态为条件的独立 evidence utility
Relation to My Work: SAPR-RAG 可沿用 MDP 视角并细化状态和奖励头

Title: HiPRAG: Hierarchical Process Rewards for Efficient Agentic Retrieval Augmented Generation
Method Summary: 用层级过程奖励判断每一步是否应该搜索
Key Contribution: 直接控制 over-search 与 under-search 并提升效率
Limitation: 强在是否搜索但弱在当前状态下搜什么和证据效用如何评估
Relation to My Work: Stop Reward 的最直接相关工作

Title: ProRAG: Process-Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Method Summary: 用 SFT warmup、MCTS-based PRM、PRM-guided refinement 和 process-supervised RL 优化 RAG 过程
Key Contribution: 将 step-level feedback 与 outcome signal 结合缓解 process hallucination
Limitation: PRM 未必区分 query/evidence/stop 的不同错误来源
Relation to My Work: 需要对比并将 PRM 拆成可解释三头 reward

Title: Search-P1: Path-Centric Reward Shaping for Stable and Efficient Agentic RAG Training
Method Summary: 用 path-centric reward 从失败样本中提取训练信号并改善 credit assignment
Key Contribution: 将 step coverage、soft scoring、self-consistency 和 reference alignment 融合到路径评分
Limitation: 路径好坏仍需进一步拆解为实体覆盖、证据支撑和停止价值
Relation to My Work: 可作为 trajectory-level reward 的重要对照

Title: Can Compact Language Models Search Like Agents? Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization for Preserving Agentic RAG Capabilities
Method Summary: 先用正确教师轨迹做 KD 冷启动再对错误 student rollout 选择性施加外部 teacher KL
Key Contribution: 在七个 QA 数据集上显著优于 PPO、纯 GKD 和离线 KD 且 HotpotQA EM 达到 0.342
Limitation: 只报告 EM 且主要验证小模型；2Wiki/MuSiQue 仍低于 teacher
Relation to My Work: 外部教师 selective OPD 的首要复现对象

Title: On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
Method Summary: 在 student 自生成序列上最小化 teacher/student 分布差异并支持 offline/on-policy 混合与多种 divergence
Key Contribution: 建立现代 LLM OPD 的通用训练框架并缓解 train-inference mismatch
Limitation: 不是 Agentic RAG 且没有多跳 QA EM/F1 证据
Relation to My Work: 作为外部教师 OPD 的理论与目标函数基础

Title: Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation of Language Models
Method Summary: teacher 高熵 token 上加入 top-k forward KL并在其他位置保留 reverse KL
Key Contribution: 缓解标准 reverse-KL OPD 的模式坍缩和高熵位置训练不稳定
Limitation: 不是 RAG 且未验证搜索动作和 EM/F1
Relation to My Work: 为 query/answer 分叉位置的 entropy-aware KL 提供依据

Title: Student-Centered Distillation Narrows the Agentic Gap Between Small and Large LLMs
Method Summary: student 先生成轨迹；teacher 只修最早错误；再从 verified prefix 做短程 RL
Key Contribution: 减少完整 teacher trajectory 模仿的误差累积并改善长轨迹 credit assignment
Limitation: 不是严格 token-level OPD且数据构造和 teacher 成本较高
Relation to My Work: 可将 failed-only OPD 进一步收敛到首错位置后的局部纠偏

Title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
Method Summary: 用同题多响应的组内 reward 统计替代 PPO critic 并将序列 advantage 广播到 token
Key Contribution: 提出 GRPO 并降低 PPO value model 成本
Limitation: 序列内无细粒度信用且存在长度与难度归一化偏置
Relation to My Work: GRPO 基础定义与当前 B 基线来源

Title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
Method Summary: 移除 reward std 和长度归一化偏置形成 Dr.GRPO
Key Contribution: 揭示 GRPO 长度偏置并提高 token 效率
Limitation: 主要验证数学推理且不解决多轮动作信用
Relation to My Work: 作为长度偏置与优化器控制基线

Title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
Method Summary: 结合 Clip-Higher;动态采样;token-level PG loss;超长 reward shaping
Key Contribution: 系统解决大规模 GRPO 稳定性和无效 prompt
Limitation: 偏工程配方且不定位多轮 Agent 动作信用
Relation to My Work: 动态采样可作为 zero-std 控制但不是主创新

Title: VinePPO: Refining Credit Assignment in RL Training of LLMs
Method Summary: 从中间 prefix 采样 continuation 以 Monte Carlo 成功率估计 step value
Key Contribution: 无需学习 critic 即获得更准确的细粒度信用
Limitation: Agentic RAG 每次 continuation 需真实检索且成本较高
Relation to My Work: 可作为 Query 分叉 value estimation 的高质量上限

Title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
Task: 多轮 Agent;搜索增强 QA
Method Summary: 结合 episode macro advantage 与相同 anchor state 下的 step micro advantage
Key Contribution: critic-free 且无需额外 rollout 的细粒度 Agent 信用分配
Limitation: 真实文本状态很少精确重复且相似分组有阈值权衡
Relation to My Work: 方向二最重要直接基线；可用 evidence-gap 状态改进 anchor

Title: Group-Normalized Implicit Value Optimization for Language Models
Method Summary: 通过组归一化分布匹配从 policy 隐式恢复 step value
Key Contribution: 无需显式 critic 的 step-level value 学习
Limitation: 评审仍质疑是否是真正的 within-trajectory credit
Relation to My Work: 要求本项目用动作过程指标证明信用落点

Title: Tree Search for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
Method Summary: 共享 prefix 构造 step tree 并计算 intra-tree/inter-tree relative advantage
Key Contribution: 在固定预算下提高分叉效率并从 outcome 构造 step credit
Limitation: 引入树超参且困难 Web Agent 增益有限
Relation to My Work: 树状 Query 分叉的主要对照；不能重复宣称树信用创新

Title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Step Rewards
Method Summary: 从 trajectory preference 交替训练隐式 PRM 并融合 step 与 episode advantage
Key Contribution: 不需显式 step label 或额外 rollout
Limitation: 引入在线 PRM 和交替训练复杂度且存在 reward hacking 风险
Relation to My Work: 若项目引入 learned evidence critic 必须对比

Title: Intrinsic Credit Assignment for Long Horizon Interaction
Dataset: 合成诊断;客服;个性化任务
Method Summary: 用每轮交互前后正确目标置信度变化作为 ΔBelief reward 并采用 turn-wise GRPO
Key Contribution: 以模型内在 belief 为势函数奖励中间信息获取
Limitation: 需要 gold target 与额外 forward；与 evidence potential 高度相邻
Relation to My Work: 本项目增量证据势函数的首要理论近邻

Title: From Outcomes to Actions: Leveraging Hindsight for Long-Horizon Language Agent Training
Method Summary: 将 state-action 投影到语义 intent space 并从成功轨迹 hindsight distribution 估计 step advantage
Key Contribution: 通过语义聚合降低长程信用方差
Limitation: 依赖额外 embedding 模型且实现含 Wasserstein/Sinkhorn 超参
Relation to My Work: semantic state grouping 和搜索 QA 的直接强基线

Title: InfoPO: Information-Driven Policy Optimization for User-Centric Agents
Task: 多轮用户交互;工具 Agent
Dataset: 意图澄清;协作编码;工具决策
Method Summary: 遮蔽某轮反馈并用后续动作分布变化计算信息增益；再按 reward 方差融合 outcome
Key Contribution: 提供 turn-level 反事实信息价值
Limitation: 文本 placeholder 可能引入混杂且依赖额外 factual/counterfactual forward
Relation to My Work: 删除 evidence 测 Answer 变化方案的直接近邻

Title: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM Agents
Method Summary: 将能力拆为 Action Selection 与 Belief Tracking 并用方向 critique 重分配轨迹内信用
Key Contribution: 揭示信息自锁并直接区分信息获取与吸收
Limitation: critique 设计可能任务特化且存在噪声/奖励投机风险
Relation to My Work: Query acquisition 与 evidence assimilation 分解的最直接近邻

Title: Milestone-Guided Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents
Method Summary: 按 milestone 切分轨迹并融合 segment temporal shaping 与全局/局部双尺度 advantage
Key Contribution: 隔离远端失败对早期正确动作的错误惩罚
Limitation: milestone 检测和粒度依赖任务结构
Relation to My Work: 可用获得第几个支持证据作为 RAG 自然 milestone

Title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
Method Summary: 用分布感知的 Riemannian clipping 平衡低概率与高概率动作更新
Key Contribution: 从几何层面缓解探索坍塌并改善 bias-variance
Limitation: 不直接提供多轮动作信用且任务集中数学
Relation to My Work: 可作为优化稳定性正交基线而非主方法

Title: Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization
Method Summary: 用几何均值替代算术均值以抑制 importance-weighted token outlier
Key Contribution: 即插即用改善 GRPO 稳定性
Limitation: 主要改变聚合方式而不解决动作级因果归因
Relation to My Work: 可作为 optimizer trick 对照

Title: Dense Reward for Free in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
Method Summary: 用 reward model attention 将终局 reward 重分配到 token 并证明 potential-based shaping 等价性
Key Contribution: 无需额外模型开销即可稠密化奖励
Limitation: attention 不等于因果归因且依赖 reward model
Relation to My Work: 为势函数和 reward redistribution 提供理论参照

Title: Attention as a Compass: Efficient Exploration for Process-Supervised RL in Reasoning Models
Method Summary: 在高 attention 推理位置分叉并按难度动态采样以维持非零 advantage
Key Contribution: 提高过程探索和采样效率
Limitation: attention 仅是相关性代理且主要验证单轮数学
Relation to My Work: zero-std 动态采样和关键位置选择参考

Title: TreePS-RAG: Tree-based Process Supervision for Reinforcement Learning in Agentic RAG
Method Summary: 在线构建 Agentic RAG rollout tree 并用 descendant outcome Monte Carlo value 形成 step advantage
Key Contribution: 直接将 outcome 转成 RAG step-level process supervision
Limitation: 未确认顶会录用且树状 rollout 实现与成本较高
Relation to My Work: 方向二最直接的 Agentic RAG 预印本基线

Title: Reinforcing Multi-Turn Reasoning in LLM Agents via Turn-Level Credit Assignment
Dataset: 两轮工具任务;搜索 QA
Method Summary: 将多轮 bandit 改写为 MDP 并以 turn-level reward/advantage 扩展 GRPO
Key Contribution: 直接验证 turn-level credit 优于 trajectory-level advantage
Limitation: 仅预印本且实验规模有限
Relation to My Work: 动作级 GRPO 的直接早期先例

Title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
Method Summary: 把任意 Agent 轨迹拆成 state-action-reward transition 并用 LightningRL 做层级信用分配
Key Contribution: 解耦 Agent 执行与训练并统一多工作流数据接口
Limitation: 偏系统框架且未确认顶会录用
Relation to My Work: 借鉴 trajectory-to-transition 接口与可观测性设计
